get_task_config: get the default task environment config with balanced collection rewarder and 50 max steps
get_pretrain_config: get the pretraining environment config with 40 max steps and default weight (1, 1)
get_fig4_task_config: get the figure 4 task config with default weight (1, -1) for negative reward
get_fig5_task_config: get a customizable figure 5 task config by passing a custom default_w weight tuple
summarize_configs: summarize the four environment configuration functions and their arena size, channels, and step settings
